scope_note: Assignment-focused short film: only Assignment 3 files are explained; A2 files are excluded with reasons (the A2 film covers them).

components.explanation: The game and its three assets: CHANGE-BRIEF.md sizes, roles, budgets, and the dated hedgehog revision (2.4 m beams -> 2.125 m). project.godot identifies the 2D game; play-01 is the student's own game screenshot.
Blender MCP build: the student's Blender session, denied MCP tools, the build scripts Claude wrote and ran (including the hand-edit step 7 in build_cover_wall.py), the exporter and the .blend files.

The Godot 3D asset room: three .glb instances at scale 1 along X, the hull-size reference box with its NOT-an-asset label, one light, a fixed camera. Shown as source, then running (Movie Maker capture).
Headless check: brief sizes in Godot axes, 0.01 m tolerance, size/lowest-y/root-scale/height-axis per .glb; 18/18 PASS, exit 0, re-run on an isolated copy; its stated limits (nothing drawn).
What Claude got wrong, what remains uncertain, human and AI contributions and the source revision, from FRICTIONAL.md (Assignment 3 part), SOURCES.md and README.md.
